'''Raggo Tolin, '''also known as''' Mad Raggo Tolin''' was a high-ranking [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] of the [[Death's Claw]] pirate band during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. On [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], He led the last pirates still on the planet during the Sith Empire's campaign to destroy the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. Praetor [[Nollus]] tasked an Imperial with killing him and his pirates.
